messages:
olivia: heads-up — master CI red on this job, failing test: session/heartbeat_timeout_test. Seen twice in the last 6h. cc @conor @tyler
tyler: saw it in the merge queue too. stacktrace points at Scheduler::tick() timeout, but it passes most local runs.
conor: can you paste the failing log and which CI image?
olivia: failing log snippet:
```
FAIL session/heartbeat_timeout_test
  expected heartbeat within 50ms, got 103ms
  at runtime/scheduler_test.cc:238
```
No seed printed. Rerun in CI succeeded once and failed again.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by olivia — queued (job id: 98765). Retries left: 2.
sree: could be noisy CI host / timer scheduling. we had similar flakes when host load spiked; tests use real steady_clock?
tyler: yes it uses steady_clock. we widened tolerance previously and that hid the underlying race. want a proper repro.
conor: can someone run `bazel test //runtime:scheduler --runs_per_test=100` on a small VM or trybot? if reproducible we can bisect commit/seed.
olivia: starting 100 runs on a VM now (lightweight image). i'll add `--test_arg=--log-timestamps` to help correlate.
tyler: if it blocks merges we could quarantine with a flaky-timer tag, but prefer to find root cause first.
conor: agreed. if you get a reproducible run N, ask ci-bot for TEST_RANDOM_SEED — that helped us bisect the allocator flake last month.
olivia: update: got 1/20 repro locally. saved full CI-like logs to s3: s3://redwood-debug/session-heartbeat/2945678901/log-1.txt
sree: great — can you also upload core dump / perf profile and ulimit/cpuinfo? might indicate scheduling/backpressure.
olivia: uploading core (core-1.gz) and perf.pb. ulimit -a and /proc/cpuinfo attached in the s3 directory as well.
tyler: i'll try a quick patch that adds a conservative 20ms spin-wait in the test to see if it stabilizes; will open an RFC PR. if that fixes flakes but masks bug, we still need root cause.
conor: sounds good. olivia, please mark the PRs that are blocked by this with an incident label if we decide to quarantine the test.
olivia: will update the PR statuses and link this thread. keeping the rerun queued for a bit; will report back with VM run stats and any bisect info. :thumbsup:
